title: The Kindly Cellar
author: Astrid Vane
blurb: August Montrose, an urban explorer mapping tunnels that aren't on any survey, documents everything, because documentation is a kind of prayer. Then the childhood imaginary friend is waiting on the porch, unchanged — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must get the family out ahead of the count, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
